name: @sleepymug/fleet-notes
description: A service of fleet's gateway, and the example of one: a notebook of short notes for each box, kept where its server runs, which a box's programs reach through the notes service's client

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
